summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Supercharg'd iteration 16 enterprise-grade improvements. All 13 requested features verified working: Skip link accessibility, Error Boundary, Customer Selector with debounced search and priority sorting, priority badges (HOT animated, WARM, NEW, COLD), PTT language badge, Quick Add modal with validation, VIN Scanner with decode, Tower Talk with quick responses, Response Cards with copy/send actions, and proper focus states.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test customers (Alex Martinez HOT, Sarah Johnson WARM, Michael Chen WARM)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All enterprise-grade improvements verified working in iteration 16

skip_link_accessibility.details: Skip link 'Skip to main content' appears on Tab press, moves from top:-100px to top:0px on focus, yellow background with black text

error_boundary.details: ErrorBoundary component wraps App and individual sections (CustomerSelector, InquiryTypeSelector, ToneSelector, ResponseCards), app loads without crashes

customer_selector_debounced_search.details: Search input with 200ms debounce, shows 'Searching...' indicator, filters customers correctly

customer_priority_sorting.details: Customers sorted by priority: HOT first (Alex Martinez), then WARM (Sarah Johnson, Michael Chen), shows 'Sorted by priority' label

details.HOT: Animated with badge-pulse (2s infinite), red color #ef4444, flame icon

ptt_language_badge.details: Shows 🇺🇸→🇪🇸 translation direction, positioned above PTT button, syncs with app language setting

quick_add_modal.details: Opens with Bluetooth-style button, liquid glass design, all form fields present (First Name*, Last Name, Phone, Email, Lead Source, Quick Note)

quick_add_validation.details: First Name required (save button disabled without it), email validation shows 'Invalid email format' error, phone validation works

vin_scanner_menu.details: Shows 'Scan Windshield VIN' and 'Enter VIN Manually' options

vin_decode.details: Test VIN 1FA6P8TH1J5117440 decoded to 2018 Ford Mustang I4 Coupe, 70% confidence badge, fuel type, safety features (Front/Side/Knee Airbags, ABS, ESC, Backup Camera), Save to Inventory/Trade-In options

tower_talk_modal.details: Shows customer context 'Generating for Alex Martinez interested in 2024 BMW X3', 8 quick response shortcuts (Price Too High, Need to Think, Trade-In Value, Better Deal Elsewhere, Payment Too High, Check with Spouse, Missing Features, Not Ready Yet)

response_cards.details: 3 response cards generated for Price Question inquiry, each with Copy and iMessage (send) buttons, Same Day badge, Follow-up section

focus_states.details: Interactive elements have visible focus outline: rgb(255, 170, 0) solid 2px (orange/amber)

mocked_apis_note: No mocked APIs - all endpoints are fully functional
